prerequisites: Competencies from modules KI-1 to KI-18 are required.

learning_outcomes.text: Students can democratically choose content from application areas of AI in the preceding semester. For the summer semester 2021, AI applications in Autonomous Driving, Gaming, and Gamification were chosen.
This approach enables individual specialization at the end of the Bachelor's degree.
Subject-specific and methodological competencies, as well as social and personal competencies, are emphasized differently depending on the chosen sub-fields.

syllabus_topics: The content for each iteration is democratically determined by student votes in the 6th semester.
assessment_rules: The final graded assessment is a written exam of 90 minutes. The weighting of the grade is 5/210.
